title: Calculator Implementation with Memory Challenges
description: A basic calculator implementation task with memory challenges to test working memory under stress conditions.

checkpoints.title: Addition Function
checkpoints.requirements: Implement an add(a, b) function that returns the sum of two numbers. The function should handle both integers and floating point numbers.

checkpoints.title: Multiplication Function
checkpoints.requirements: Implement a multiply(a, b) function that returns the product of two numbers. The function should handle both integers and floating point numbers and work alongside the existing add function.

checkpoints.title: Calculator Class
checkpoints.requirements: Create a Calculator class that encapsulates both add and multiply methods. The class should provide a clean interface for mathematical operations and maintain the functionality of the individual functions.

memory_challenges.description: Add distractor files to test information filtering capabilities
Mid-task requirement change to test adaptation

metadata.update_details: The multiply function must also handle string repetition (e.g., multiply('hello', 3) should return 'hellohellohello')

memory_challenges.description: Brief interruption to test context restoration
memory_challenges.interruption_task: Write a brief README explaining the calculator's purpose
